apis.summary: — Start a staged SAP functional location and equipment import; returns preview.
apis.details: Permission field.site.import Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 2 s to preview start; job async Errors 409 FIELD-IMP-409-RUNNING: another job for this connection is running 422 FIELD-IMP-422-MASK: filter prefix invalid 502 FIELD-IMP-502-SAP: SAP unreachable Request {"connection_id": "0192f0a1-...", "filter_prefix": "IN01-TWR-0042", "mode": "delta"} Response {"job_id": "0192f0b2-...", "status": "preview", "counts": {"new": 31, "changed": 2, "moved": 0, "removed": 1, "rejected": 1}}

apis.summary: — Location tree with installed equipment per position.
apis.details: Permission field.site.read Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 150 ms Errors 404 FIELD-SITE-404: site not found or out of scope Request {} Response {"site": {"erp_ref": "IN01-TWR-0042", "children": [{"kind": "tower", "code": "T01", "children": [{"kind": "sector", "code": "SA", "children": [{"kind": "level", "code": "L03", "height_m": 40.0}]}]}]}}

apis.summary: — Check in with geofence and permit.
apis.details: Permission field.visit.create Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 120 ms Errors 403 FIELD-VIS-403-GEOFENCE: outside radius after accuracy 422 FIELD-VIS-422-ACCURACY: accuracy > 50 m 422 FIELD-VIS-422-PERMIT: permit missing or expired 409 FIELD-VIS-409-OPEN: open visit exists for this user Request {"permit_ref": "PTW-2026-11-0412", "permit_valid_until": "2026-11-24T17:00:00Z", "lat": 18.52043, "lon": 73.856743, "accuracy_m": 12.0, "captured_at": "2026-11-24T09:02:11Z", "baro_hpa": 948.21} Response {"visit_id": "0192f1c3-...", "status": "checked_in", "timer_interval_min": 20}

apis.summary: — Heartbeat, check-in, status change or check-out (If-Match).
apis.details: Permission field.visit.create Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 100 ms Errors 412 FIELD-VIS-412-ETAG: stale version 409 FIELD-VIS-409-CLOSED: visit already checked out Request {"action": "check_in", "occurred_at": "2026-11-24T09:21:40Z"} Response {"status": "on_structure", "next_due_at": "2026-11-24T09:41:40Z"}

apis.summary: — Offline site pack manifest with chunk URLs and snapshot version.
apis.details: Permission field.site.read Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 300 ms manifest Errors 304: If-None-Match matches 404 FIELD-SITE-404 Request {} Response {"snapshot_version": "erp-2026-11-23T22:00Z#418", "size_bytes": 41877211, "chunks": [{"name": "tree", "sha256": "9f2c...", "url": "signed"}, {"name": "models/RRU@1.3.0", "sha256": "a1d4...", "url": "signed"}]}

apis.summary: — Run reconciliation for a tower or whole task; returns findings summary.
apis.details: Permission field.task.read Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 400 ms for 200 lines Errors 409 FIELD-AUD-409-SIGNED: task already signed off Request {"tower_location_id": "0192f..."} Response {"matched": 20, "serial_mismatch": 1, "tower_only": 1, "erp_only": 2, "misplaced": 0, "completeness": 0.833}

apis.summary: — Completeness per site, tower, sector, level.
apis.details: Permission field.task.read Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 120 ms Errors 404 FIELD-TASK-404 Request {} Response {"site": 0.917, "towers": [{"code": "T01", "value": 0.917, "sectors": [{"code": "A", "value": 1.0}, {"code": "B", "value": 0.75, "empty_scope": false}]}]}

apis.summary: — Stage or confirm install, dismantle or replace at a position.
apis.details: Permission field.post.request (stage), field.post.confirm (confirm) Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 120 ms (post async) Errors 409 FIELD-EQP-409-ALREADY-INSTALLED: serial installed elsewhere 422 FIELD-EQP-422-BOM-INCOMPLETE: serialised parts not captured 422 FIELD-IDEM-422-BODY: same key, different body 423 FIELD-SAFE-423-UNCONFIRMED: device reported harness unconfirmed Request {"type": "replace", "position_location_id": "0192f...", "old_serial": "21A7K0093", "new_serial": "21B3M0411", "material": "RRU-4T-B3", "bom_captures": [{"balloon_no": 3, "serial": "PSU88213"}], "occurred_at": "2026-11-24T10:14:02Z", "confirm": true} Response {"events": [{"id": "0192f...", "type": "dismantle", "queue_key": "IN01-TWR-0042-T01", "seq": 17, "status": "queued"}, {"id": "0192f...", "type": "install", "seq": 18, "status": "queued"}]}

Permission field.post.confirm Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 120 ms Errors 409 FIELD-EQP-409-NOT-POSTED: use undo on staged event 409 FIELD-EQP-409-SUPERSEDED: later event on serial exists; reverse that first Request {"reason": "wrong position"} Response {"reversal_event_id": "0192f...", "ref_doc_no": "EQ-INST-10000123", "status": "queued"}

apis.summary: — Ordered trail of locations for a serial.
apis.details: Permission field.site.read Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 150 ms Errors 404 FIELD-EQP-404-SERIAL Request {} Response {"serial": "21A7K0093", "points": [{"seq": 1, "type": "issue", "label": "Plant 1100 / SL 0001", "at": "2026-06-02T08:00:00Z"}, {"seq": 2, "type": "install", "label": "IN01-TWR-0042 T01 Sector A L3 P02", "at": "2026-06-05T11:20:00Z"}]}

apis.summary: — 3D route with climb weighting and guidance.
apis.details: Permission field.site.read Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 50 ms Errors 404 FIELD-GRAPH-404-NODE 422 FIELD-GRAPH-422-NO-ROUTE Request {} Response {"cost": 131.5, "climb_m": 40.0, "walk_m": 11.5, "nodes": ["ground-gate", "ladder-foot-T01", "rp-L2", "rp-L3"], "guidance": "Climb 40 m to Level 3 platform. Clip in at every rest platform."}

apis.summary: — Upload a draft model version (multipart .glb + BOM CSV).
apis.details: Permission field.model.edit Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 1 s accept; validation async <= 30 s Errors 413 FIELD-MOD-413-SIZE: > 25 MB 422 FIELD-MOD-422-INVALID: validation issues listed 409 FIELD-MOD-409-VERSION: version exists Request {"equipment_class": "RRU", "version": "1.3.0", "glb": "(binary)", "bom_csv": "(text)"} Response {"id": "0192f...", "status": "validating"}

Permission field.model.publish Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 300 ms Errors 409 FIELD-MOD-409-NOT-VALID 401 FIELD-AUTH-401-STEPUP: step-up required Request {} Response {"status": "published", "balloons_assigned": 2, "balloons_kept": 14}

apis.summary: — BOM with balloons, serialised flags, node mapping, explode vectors.
apis.details: Permission field.site.read Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 100 ms Errors 404 FIELD-MOD-404 Request {} Response {"items": [{"balloon_no": 3, "part_no": "PSU-48V-2K", "qty": 1, "serialised": true, "node_names": ["psu"], "explode_vector": [0, 0.12, 0]}]}

apis.summary: — Upload summarised safety events in device order.
apis.details: Permission field.visit.create Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 100 ms Errors 409 FIELD-SAFE-409-SEQ-GAP: earlier device_seq missing (client resends) Request {"events": [{"device_seq": 41, "type": "harness_confirmed", "altitude_m": 40.2, "occurred_at": "2026-11-24T09:58:12Z"}]} Response {"accepted": 1, "duplicates": 0}

apis.summary: — Mismatch queue with filters; decision via POST /v1/mismatches/{id}/decision.
apis.details: Permission field.exception.decide Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 200 ms Errors 403 FIELD-EXC-403-SOD: decider captured this serial 409 FIELD-EXC-409-RESOLVED Request {"query": "?site_id=...&class=serial_mismatch&limit=50", "decision_body": {"decision": "update_erp", "note": "Plate photo clear"}} Response {"items": [{"id": "0192f...", "class": "serial_mismatch", "expected_serial": "21A7K0098", "found_serial": "21A7K0093", "verify_status": "verified", "crop_url": "signed", "age_h": 5}], "next_cursor": "..."}

Permission field.report.export Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO Generation <= 60 s for 500 findings Errors 409 FIELD-RPT-409-RUNNING Request {"format": "csv"} Response {"report_id": "0192f...", "status": "queued"}

apis.summary: — Installed base by serial or site for Phase 5.
apis.details: Permission field.installed_base.read Idempotent yes, Idempotency-Key required SLO p95 <= 80 ms Errors 400 FIELD-IB-400-FILTER: serial or site_id required Request {"query": "?serial=21B3M0411"} Response {"items": [{"serial_no": "21B3M0411", "erp_equipment_no": "10004417", "site_erp_ref": "IN01-TWR-0042", "erp_ref": "IN01-TWR-0042-T01-SA-L03-P02", "since": "2026-11-24T10:14:02Z"}]}
